title: Navy intelligence visits Frances Swan

tellings.quote: and then Navy intelligence picks up on this woman and they go and visit her in 1954

plain: In 1954, Navy intelligence is said to have taken notice of a woman named Frances Swan in Eliot, Maine, and gone to visit her. The researcher Grant Cameron tells this without naming a source. He credits a document he describes as coming from the FBI or Navy intelligence about Swan, and he also names a man called Wilbert B. Smith. If true, it would mean the military was quietly following up on her in the 1950s.
